instruction.text: Does the object have one owner or more than one owner? Fill in the gap with the correct possessive.

hint.text:
If there is one owner, the apostrophe goes before the 's'.
If there is more than one owner, the apostrophe goes after the 's'.

For example:
The cat’s food belongs to one cat.
The cats’ food belongs to more than one cat.

If there is more than one owner, the apostrophe goes <prosody rate ='90%'>after</prosody> the s. <break time='1000ms'/>For example: The cat’s food belongs to one cat. The cats’ food belongs to more than one cat.

atoms.a: The lettuce belongs to the rabbits.
The egg belongs to the chicken.
The wings belong to the birds.
The leaves belong to the snail.
